topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Well now, that’s a queer thing, finding something you can’t rightly recall hiding. Me, I’ve never seen such a sight. Must be something from yon days when the village was different, before the old mill was built, mayhaps. The world turns, and what was once underfoot can rise up and surprise you. The soil holds many secrets, as the priest says, and this capsule’s a proof of it. Only the saints know what’s inside. It feels as if the ground itself is talking, whispering of times long past. Best we see what it holds, and maybe learn a thing or two.
